## Install

It lands in `src/rost/timeline/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/timeline.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

| `children` | slot |  |  |

## Anatomy

- `root`: An `<ol>`, so the events are counted. The items sit straight on top of each other: each one's line runs down to the next one's dot.

## When to use

- **The history of one thing.** An invoice that was drafted, sent, opened and paid. A vault that was set up and then shared.

## When not to use

- **Steps still to do.** A Timeline is what already happened. Steps someone has to go through are a **Stepper**.
- **A feed.** Many unrelated things from many places. That's a list of **ListItems**.

## Behaviour

It lays the items in a column and tells the last one it's last, so its line stops at its dot.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: `<ol>`, so a screen reader says how many events there are.
- **Name**: Give it an `aria-label` when the heading above it doesn't say what it's the history of.

## Content

Each item says what happened in a few words, past tense: Sent to Client 1, Paid.
